template.name: viewDetailFormJs
template.content:
<#list table.columnList as c>
<#if c.dpyTp == "ueditor">
/*实例化编辑器到id为 container 的 dom 容器上*/
var ${c.javaFieldId}UE = UE.getEditor('${c.javaFieldId}');
</#if>
</#list>

$(document).ready(function(){
	/*把修详情面内容显示出来*/
	parent.window.$("#iframe_detail").show();
	<#if table.pkList?? && (table.pkList?size>0)>
	<#list table.columnList as c>
	<#if c.mainKeyFlg?? && c.mainKeyFlg == "1">
	/*从session中拿出${c.javaFieldId}*/
	var HID_${c.javaFieldId} = $.session.get('HID_${c.javaFieldId}');
	/*从session中移除${c.javaFieldId}*/
	$.session.remove('HID_${c.javaFieldId}');
	$("#HID_${c.javaFieldId}").val(HID_${c.javaFieldId});
	</#if>
	</#list>
	<#else>
	/*从session中拿出HID_id*/
	var HID_id = $.session.get('HID_id');
	/*从session中移除HID_id*/
	$.session.remove('HID_id');
	$("#HID_id").val(HID_id);
	</#if>

	getDetail(<#if table.pkList?? && (table.pkList?size>0)><#assign count=0><#list table.columnList as c><#if c.mainKeyFlg?? && c.mainKeyFlg == "1"><#assign count=count+1>HID_${c.javaFieldId}<#if (count<table.pkList?size)>, </#if></#if></#list><#else>HID_id</#if>);
	
	/*取消按钮*/
	$('#cancleBtn').click(function(){
		cancle();
	});
	
});

function cancle(){
	parent.window.$("a[href^='#tab_list']").click();
}

/*查询明细*/
function getDetail(<#if table.pkList?? && (table.pkList?size>0)><#assign count=0><#list table.columnList as c><#if c.mainKeyFlg?? && c.mainKeyFlg == "1"><#assign count=count+1>${c.javaFieldId}<#if (count<table.pkList?size)>, </#if></#if></#list><#else>id</#if>){
	console.info('get ${procClssName} info......');
	$.post(ctx + "/${urlPrefix}/get", {<#if table.pkList?? && (table.pkList?size>0)><#assign count=0><#list table.columnList as c><#if c.mainKeyFlg?? && c.mainKeyFlg == "1"><#assign count=count+1>${c.javaFieldId}:${c.javaFieldId}<#if (count<table.pkList?size)>, </#if></#if></#list><#else>id:id</#if>}, function(data){
		if(data.returnCode!==undefined && "0000"!=data.returnCode){ 
			var errMsg = "错误信息["+data.message+"]"; 
			showContent(errMsg,"error");	
		}else {
			for(var i = 0 ; i < data.dataSetResult.length; i++){
				for(var j = 0 ; j < data.dataSetResult[i].data.length; j++){
					var jsonObj = data.dataSetResult[i].data[j];
					console.info(jsonObj);
					<#list table.columnList as c>
					<#if c.insertFlg?? && c.insertFlg == "1" && (c.isNotBaseField || c.simpleJavaField == 'rmrk')>
					<#if c.dpyTp == "select">
					$('#${c.javaFieldId}').multiselect("select", [jsonObj.${c.javaFieldId}]).multiselect('rebuild');
					$('#${c.javaFieldId}').multiselect("disable");
					<#elseif c.dpyTp == "checkbox">
					setCheckboxVal('${c.javaFieldId}',jsonObj.${c.javaFieldId});
					<#elseif c.dpyTp == "radiobox">
					setRadioVal('${c.javaFieldId}',jsonObj.${c.javaFieldId});
					<#elseif c.dpyTp == "dateselect">
					setDateValue('${c.javaFieldId}', jsonObj.${c.javaFieldId});
					<#elseif c.dpyTp == "userselect" || c.dpyTp == "officeselect" || c.dpyTp == "areaselect" || c.dpyTp == "roleselect">
					$('#${c.javaFieldId}Name').val(jsonObj.${c.javaFieldId}Name);
					<#elseif c.dpyTp == "iconselect">
					$('#${c.javaFieldId}').val(jsonObj.${c.javaFieldId});
					${c.javaFieldId}IconPreview(); /*图标预览*/
					setIconSelectDisabled('${c.javaFieldId}');
					<#elseif c.dpyTp == "fileselect" || c.dpyTp == "fileinput">
					$('#${c.javaFieldId}').val(jsonObj.${c.javaFieldId});
					${c.javaFieldId}Preview(); /*文件预览*/
					setFileSelectDisabled('${c.javaFieldId}');
					<#elseif c.dpyTp == "ueditor">
					/*实例后在ready方(组件渲染后事件)中设置内容*/
                    ${c.javaFieldId}UE.ready(function() {
                    	${c.javaFieldId}UE.setContent(jsonObj.${c.javaFieldId});
                    	${c.javaFieldId}UE.setDisabled('fullscreen');
                    });
					<#else>
					$('#${c.javaFieldId}').val(jsonObj.${c.javaFieldId});	
					</#if>
					</#if>
					</#list>
				}
			}

		}
	},
    "json");
}
